messages:
anya: Heads-up — Acme asked for a permanent routing override to pin traffic to us-east citing data residency. They want a header-based override we can honor at the gateway.

kevin: Details? TTL? is this for Dedicated or hosted? Any compliance implications?

anya: Dedicated. Ticket: INC-1892. Example header they suggested:
```
X-Org-Route: us-east
X-Org-Force: true
```
They explicitly asked for no sampling and for it to be sticky.

olga: Not comfortable with permanent allowlist without adjudication + audit + rollback. We need a workflow: request -> review -> signed approval -> system-applied TTL -> audit entry.

maria: +1. Auto-expire after 30d unless legal signs off. Emit telemetry: route.override.requested / route.override.approved with approver, reason, expiry.

kevin: UX question: should Console expose a "Request override" CTA or make it admin-only? I prefer a request flow (PR-like) so Account Eng + SRE can comment.

anya: Proposed minimal flow: rep files request -> SRE + AE triage -> Product Ops approves/denies -> system issues a claim token and applies a sticky route + TTL -> audit log.

maria: Implementation note: do NOT accept raw headers from customers. Gateway should only honor overrides with a signed claim or console-issued token. Sketch:
```
POST /internal/route-claims
body: {"org": "acme", "region": "us-east", "ttl": 2592000}
returns: {"claim": "eyJhbGci..."}
```
Gateway verifies signature on claim before applying sticky route.

kevin: Claim token + signature is good. Also need metrics: active_overrides_count, override_apply_latency, override_reject_rate.

olga: Add "audit export" button in Console (CSV/JSON) with filters (org, approver, time range) for compliance. Also require two approvers for >100k qps customers.

adjudication-bot: Draft policy created: https://redwood.internal/policies/route-adjudication-v1.0 — please review. :white_check_mark: 

anya: Can someone mock the Console flow and write the internal API spec? I'll coordinate legal for retention and approvals.

maria: I'll draft the API spec and open a PR in eng-platform. Will include HMAC signing details and claim format.

kevin: I'll own metrics + dashboard. Will add per-org Grafana panels for override count + latency. ETA: EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

olga: Adding audit export to compliance backlog.

anya: Thanks — let's sync in the weekly eng-platform sync.
